works.description_zh: 随着人类文明的飞速发展，地球的温室效应如同喷吐烈焰的巨龙。人类发展出的工业技术也引发了战争。与此同时，各种自然灾害也会对地球造成巨大破坏。如果人类不保护地球，地球终将彻底崩溃。
works.title: Apocalypse
works.description: With the rapid development of human civilization, the greenhouse effect on the earth is like a dragon spewing raging fire to the earth. Humans also developed industrial technologies to cause wars. At the same time, various natural disasters will also cause huge damage to the earth. If human beings do not protect the earth, the earth will collapse completely.
